title.fallback: A short page made for {{ account.name }}

intro.fallback: I made this page for {{ account.name }} instead of sending another email. It is short, and the three points under it say why I think a conversation is worth your time.

recipe.rubric:
Grade the title, the intro and the three reasons the way the reader at {{ account.name }} sees them: a page from one person, with a short video on top, that says why it was made for their company. 10 is a page the reader finishes in 30 seconds and believes was written for them.
Score these, 0 to 10 each:
- specific: each reason names a fact about {{ account.name }} that the inputs below hold, not a line that fits any company in the industry.
- plain: short sentences a person would say out loud. No marketing adjectives, no jargon, no stacked nouns.
- honest: nothing claimed about {{ account.name }}, its numbers, its tools or its customers that the inputs do not support, and nothing claimed about what we sell unless the knowledge input holds it.
- flow: the title says the topic, the intro says why now, and each of the three reasons adds a point the others do not.
Answer yes or no:
- would_read: would a busy person in this role read all three reasons?
- weird_word: is there a phrase a person would not say out loud? Quote it.
Automatic fail: an em dash or en dash, an exclamation mark, the person's name, a greeting or a sign-off, the words video, recorded or watch in the intro, a number the inputs do not hold, a price, an email address or a phone number, or two reasons that make the same point.
Inputs for checking. Summary: {{ account.dossier.summary | default: 'none' }} Why now: {{ account.dossier.why_now | default: 'none' }} Signals: {{ account.signals | json }} Knowledge: {{ knowledge.stable | json }} Notes: {{ knowledge.scoped | json }}
